text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Pearl! Hehe, the wait is
over!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, you mean it's party time?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When you kicked me out of the room
this
morning, I had a feeling a surprise
was coming.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ☆ Kawakami and I teamed up to
make lots
and lots of yummy food.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Cakes and tea, chanko with fried rice
and
curry—the table might splinter
under the feast
we've prepared!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, fabulous! You've outdone yourselves—it all sounds so global!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is going to be one spectacular
day—no
doubt about it! Consider your
surprise a success!
